answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 8621 Country: India Title: who introused tarawee in ramzan how many rakath in the time of mohammed prophet send in details. thankyou Question: who introused tarawee in ramzan how many rakath in the time of mohammed prophet send in details. thankyou Answer ID: 8621 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1370/220=TL/1429) The tarawih in Ramadhan is offered from the time of the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ). I t is proved that the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) himself offered twenty rakah tarawih and this is followed by the overwhelming majority of the Ummah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
